points.description: States that strain is a ratio (or relative/proportional measure) comparing change in length (deformation/elongation) to the original length.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only says it is the change in length or deformation, or a ratio/measure of deformation without referring to the original length.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for the core idea: change in length divided by original length, in any wording (e.g. 'elongation per unit length'). Give 1 mark if the answer mentions only deformation/change in length, or a ratio without saying what it is compared to. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers; extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the idea.
